market_education.summary_en: Today's market was largely directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 up a modest 0.5%, suggesting no strong catalyst pushed investors decisively toward risk-on or risk-off positioning. In the absence of major news, price action reflected routine trading rather than a reaction to a specific headline. Sector-level moves were likely driven by individual stock fundamentals and technical setups rather than broad macro themes.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢反覆，納指及標普500均只錄得約0.5%的溫和升幅，反映市場缺乏明確催化劑,投資者未有明顯轉向風險偏好或避險情緒。在缺乏重大消息的情況下，價格走勢較多反映日常交易操作，而非對個別頭條新聞的即時反應。板塊表現預料主要由個股基本面及技術走勢主導，而非宏觀主題帶動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When picking a stock, relying on just one indicator (like RSI or MACD alone) can be misleading — random noise can trigger a single signal without real momentum behind it. Multi-signal confirmation means waiting until several independent indicators (RSI, MACD crossover, price vs. moving average, and volume) all point the same bullish direction together, which is a stronger sign of genuine buying interest.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 選股時只依賴單一指標（例如RSI或MACD）可能會產生誤導，因為隨機的市場雜訊有時會觸發單一訊號，而背後未必有真正的動力支持。多重訊號確認是指等待多個獨立指標（RSI、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大）同時發出一致的看漲訊號，這樣才是較可靠的真實買盤強勁的跡象。
